articles.summary: HOUSTON , Oct. 22, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- NCS Multistage Holdings, Inc. (“NCS” or the “Company”) (NASDAQ:NCSM) will host a conference call to discuss its third quarter 2025 results on Thursday, October 30, 2025 at 7:30 a.m. Central Time ( 8:30 a.m. Eastern Time ).
articles.title: NCS Multistage Holdings, Inc. Schedules Third Quarter 2025 Earnings Release and Conference Call

articles.summary: Third Quarter Results Total revenues of $46 .5 million, a 6% year-over-year improvement Net income of $3.8 million and diluted earnings per share of $1.37 , compared to net income of $4 .1 million and diluted earnings per share of $1 .60 in the same quarter of 2024 Adjusted EBITDA of $7 .0 million,
articles.title: NCS Multistage Holdings, Inc. Announces Third Quarter 2025 Results
